d: CLEAR Engineering Consultants is seeking a skilled and detail-oriented Senior Accountant to join our Finance Department in Riyadh.

The ideal candidate will have strong experience in accounting operations, financial reporting, budgeting, and cost control. The role involves managing daily accounting activities, preparing financial statements, handling monthly closing, monitoring project costs, and ensuring compliance with applicable accounting standards and Saudi regulations.

The successful candidate should have strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and the ability to work effectively within a professional team environment. Experience in engineering consultancy or construction companies is highly preferred.
